reserves.name: Spiko EUTBL tokenized Eurozone Treasury-bill fund shares
reserves.issuerOrObligor: Spiko euTBL fund portfolio of short-duration Eurozone sovereign Treasury bills

reserveReview.rationale: At Ethereum block 25530533, EUR0's deployed TokenMapping returned exactly one eligible collateral token, Spiko euTBL at 0xa0769f7a8fc65e47de93797b4e21c073c117fc80. The published EUR0 collateral treasury held 192,323.85243 euTBL against 191,181.471117208263827024 EUR0 supply. The sole eligible and held collateral therefore maps the full dependency relationship to the tracked EUTBL asset.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Deployed EUR0 TokenMapping eligible-collateral set and euTBL balance of the published EUR0 collateral treasury at Ethereum block 25530533
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The deployed token mapping contains one collateral token and the published treasury holds that token; no additional eligible collateral was present.

providers.name: Usual EUR0 collateral treasury and mint engine contracts

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The deployed collateral mapping and published treasury identify the euTBL dependency, but the reviewed public sources do not establish legal segregation, fund-depositary insolvency treatment, or rehypothecation terms for the full EUR0 route.
